results.name: Free Low Poly Cargo Container Box | Game Ready
results.description:
## Free Low Poly Cargo Container Box

A simple **free low-poly cargo container box** suitable for games, environments, animations, scenes, and general 3D projects.

### Included

* Low-poly cargo container model
* Separate door parts for easy opening/animation
* Included texture image
* Preview camera

The model also includes **image-based wear/details** on the container to give it a more used and weathered appearance.

The doors are separate objects, so they can easily be moved or animated if you want the container to open.

**Note:** A preview camera is included in the file. It was originally used for the model preview and can be removed if you don't need it.

### Features

* Free to use
* Low poly
* Separate doors
* Easy to animate
* Textured
* Suitable for games and renders
* Simple and lightweight
